weights.why: each package's share of the priced bill, with work the bill never priced valued at its labour — Rs 824 a man-day, which is this bill's own installation total divided by the man-days the same scope generates

projection.why: the site has gained 0.58 points of completion per working day across 12 full walks between 2026-07-18 and 2026-08-11. At that rate the remaining 81 points take 141 working days and the floor finishes 2027-01-22.

shift.name: General shift with overtime
shift.why: the same crew held back four hours, paid at overtime. Twelve hours on the floor produces about 1.35 days of work, not 1.5 — the last hours are the tired ones. The commonest answer on a fit-out that is three weeks behind

siteWorkBy.why: the client's snag walk, de-snagging to sign-off and the deep clean are 19 working days that no crew size compresses. Working back from 2026-10-21, every trade has to be off the floor by 2026-09-29

handover.source: the signed agreement — 75 days from handover of premises on 8 Jun 2026
handover.why: the contractual date, and the one LD exposure hangs on. The other three stated dates are not wrong, they are tighter, and the engine reports each as a variance against this one rather than replacing it. The date is a CONSTRAINT, not an outcome: the programme is built to land on it, and where it cannot, the engine says what it would take rather than quietly finishing late.
